The '''Tyrena cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Description==
The Tyrena cantina followed a floorplan extremely similar to other cantinas on several planets throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which was most likely a prefabricated design. It had several alcoves surrounding a central bar, with a single [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] on duty at all times. The front and rear entrances were equipped with [[EPT-212]] [[Droid detector/Legends|droid detectors]] and seating was plentiful.

==Patrons==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Tyrena cantina was hospitable to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and various criminal elements. [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] spent most of her time there, as did several of her underlings. Despite these fringe elements, several [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] members were also usually present.
